author: National Geographic
description:
What was it like during the Golden age of Piracy? In this DRAIN THE OCEANS MEGA episode, join National Geographic to examine and uncover shipwrecks and lost treasures. The Drain the Oceans team analyzes the richest wrecks ever find, the long-lost shipwrecks of the legendary pirate captains of the Caribbean, and the battle for the Black Swan, worth over half-a billion dollars. 

Featuring three, full episodes: 

Sunken Treasure Ships - 00:00 
Treasure hunting has captured our imaginations for centuries. Draining the oceans reveals the richest wrecks ever found.

Pirate Ships of the Caribbean - 47:02 
Uncovering the long-lost shipwrecks of legendary captains reveals why the Caribbean — more than all other seas — became famous for pirates.

The Battle for the Black Swan - 1:33:54
Archaeologists and treasure hunters battle it out over half a billion dollars worth of gold and silver. Who will win the Battle for the Black Swan?
